title: Florida House, District 45
what_it_does: Represents District 45 (Parts of Orange, Osceola) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Erin Huntley
candidates.occupation: Former Orange County Republican Party chair; private-sector leadership-development and HR professional (Walt Disney Parks, JetBlue, DECA); Florida Virtual School trustee
candidates.background: Huntley, a mother of three who has lived in Central Florida for nearly two decades, chaired the Orange County Republican Party and was appointed by Gov. DeSantis to the Florida Virtual School Board of Trustees. Her private-sector career includes roles at Walt Disney Parks, JetBlue Airways and DECA Inc.

candidates.name: Leonard Spencer
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Spencer, 55, of Gotha, holds finance degrees from Tuskegee University and the University of Alabama and has worked as a business executive partnering large companies with small businesses. He unseated Rep. Carolina Amesty in 2024 and is the only House Democrat representing a district carried by Donald Trump.
